title: Worker view pivot sample ordering
summary: Recover the signed-key comparison network used to order pivot samples at VA 0x42c5c0.
test_description: Compare all pointer slots against the original for lengths 1 through 120, including the 40-slot threshold, ascending, descending, equal, duplicate, signed extreme and pseudorandom keys; check item opaque bytes and FS head.
known_limits: Requires valid inclusive slot pointers and valid item pointers, as in the original caller.
The identity and meaning of the signed field at offset 0x188 are unresolved.
The original internal register calling convention is represented by a portable function interface.
